name: drug-discovery-agent-skills
title_zh: 小分子与蛋白药物研发的Agent技能全家桶
tagline_zh: 从化学信息学到分子动力学，从靶点发现到蛋白设计，一套技能覆盖药物研发全流程，让AI代理直接上手干活。
tagline_en: From cheminformatics to molecular dynamics, target discovery to protein design—a full skill suite that gets AI.
desc_en: Agent Skills for small-molecule and protein therapeutics: cheminformatics, molecular ML, docking and dynamics, protein design platforms, and target-discovery knowledge graphs.
why_zh: 不是零散脚本，而是按药物研发管线组织的模块化技能，每个都封装好输入输出，可组合成复杂工作流，且持续更新。
why_en: Not scattered scripts, but a pipeline-organized modular suite with clean I/O, composable into complex workflows, and actively.
limit_zh: 需要自行配置计算环境和依赖（如RDKit、OpenMM等）；技能覆盖研发环节，不包含实验验证或临床数据。
limit_en: Requires manual setup of compute env & deps (RDKit, OpenMM, etc.); covers R&D stages only, no experimental or clinical data; outside.
